newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy 500,000/bbls May reformate.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy 500,000/bbls May reformate.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 500,000 barrels of leaded and unleaded 95-octane reformate for first-half May delivery, a company official said on Thursday.
The tender which closes April 1 and is valid for two days, requires the two 250,000-barrel cargoes to be delivered to Keelung, Taichung, Kaohsiung or Shalung.
Taiwan last week bought by tender, 250,000 barrels of unleaded reformate at $28.60 per barrel, cost and-freight Taiwan for April 16-30 arrival.
